dict.string: Wisp listens while you hold the hotkey so you can talk to it. Your voice is transcribed on this Mac and never leaves it.
Wisp looks at your screen to answer questions about what you are seeing. Screenshots are read by a model running on this Mac and are never uploaded.
Wisp turns your speech into text using on-device recognition. Nothing you say is sent anywhere.
Wisp reads your upcoming events on this Mac to show them in the notch. Your calendar is read on-device and never uploaded.
Wisp reads your upcoming events on this Mac to show them in the notch. Your calendar is read on-device and never uploaded.
Wisp reads your reminders on this Mac to show them in the notch, and adds a reminder when you ask it to. Your reminders are read on-device and never uploaded by Wisp.
Wisp reads your reminders on this Mac to show them in the notch, and adds a reminder when you ask it to. Your reminders are read on-device and never uploaded by Wisp.

Wisp controls your web browser (Chrome or Safari) when you ask it to — opening tabs, going to sites and working through pages — asks Music or Spotify what is currently playing to show it in the notch, and sends a message from Messages when you ask it to text someone (always after you confirm), and reads your Apple Notes when you ask it to import them into your brain (read on this Mac, never uploaded).
Wisp looks up the person you ask it to text — like "mom" or "sarah" — in your contacts on this Mac. Your contacts are read on-device and never uploaded by Wisp.
Wisp uses your location to find places near you — like coffee or restaurants — when you ask. Your location is used on this Mac to search Apple Maps and is never uploaded by Wisp.
